scripts.shell:web-server-mac: concurrently -n "FE,BE" --kill-others "pnpm --filter uap_web dev" "cd backend/uap-server && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && ./gradlew bootRun --no-daemon"
scripts.shell:web-server-win: concurrently -n "FE,BE" --kill-others "pnpm --filter uap_web dev" "powershell -NoProfile -Command \"cd backend/uap-server; Get-Content .env | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\\s*([^#][^=]*)=(.*)$') { [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($matches[1].Trim(), $matches[2].Trim(), 'Process') } }; $env:SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL = 'jdbc:mysql://' + $env:DB_HOST + ':' + $env:DB_PORT + '/' + $env:DB_NAME; .\\gradlew.bat bootRun --no-daemon\""
scripts.shell:web-server-linux: concurrently -n "FE,BE" --kill-others "pnpm --filter uap_web dev" "cd backend/uap-server && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && ./gradlew bootRun --no-daemon"
scripts.shell:mobile-server-mac: concurrently -n "MOBILE,BE" --kill-others "pnpm --filter uap_mobile exec expo start --dev-client --clear" "cd backend/uap-server && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && ./gradlew bootRun --no-daemon"
